text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm out and about with
Kawakami
Princess...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow her gaze and see a claw machine
filled
with Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No thanks. I'm not interested in that kind
of thing
at all.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be very elegant of a princess
to get
obsessed with a claw machine.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Besides which, it's impossible to grab a
plushie
with such a weak claw!
IMPOSSIBLE, I tell you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, let's just forget it. That weak little
baby
claw's not gonna—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Now that you mention it, in Princess
Fighter
episode twenty-six, they say,
"Don't be deceived
by the size of a
crab's claw!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"When used the right way, even the
smallest
pinch can capture a massive
whale!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please show me the strength of
that tiny
crab!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
